name: cat_cru_struggle4
subject: small black cat in a purple witch hat with a star and bell, purple cape, tiny dark nose, eyes closed as thin curved lines, small closed mouth, pink goo smeared on its belly, pinned flat with arms spread
desc: struggles while stuck in place, keeping exactly the same calm closed-eye face: only the torso and head move, twisting and squirming left and right and the head shaking a little, the tail swishing. Both hands, both arms and both legs and feet do not move at all. Same three-quarter view facing left, same face, same size, loops back to the first pose
